permitDetails.description: Permit-level metadata extracted exactly from the document. Do not infer or normalize beyond date formatting.

permitNumber.description: The permit number or registration identifier exactly as written (e.g., '52432', '21050040'). Extract the primary numeric/alphanumeric identifier, excluding labels like 'Registration No.:' or 'Permit'. If multiple identifiers exist, select the primary one and document others in extractionNotes.

permitIssuanceDate.description: Date the permit was issued in YYYY-MM-DD format if unambiguous; otherwise null.

permitExpirationDate.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format if explicitly stated; otherwise null.

facilityName.description: Facility name exactly as written in the permit. Do not normalize.

facilityAddress.description: Full facility street address exactly as written. Some states include county and zip in the address field (e.g., 'Street, City, County, Zip'), others separate them. Extract the complete address string as it appears.

facilityCounty.description: County name exactly as written in the permit. May appear within the address field in some states or as a separate field in others. Extract the county designation regardless of location.

stateFacilityID.description: State-assigned facility identifier at the permit level, exactly as written. This is the overarching facility identifier for the entire permitted facility, distinct from individual equipment identifiers. States use different terminology: Illinois uses 'I.D. No.' (e.g., '031440ANI', '031471AEN'), Virginia uses 'Facility ID No.' or 'Registration No.' (e.g., '51-167-00092', '11790', '52432'), Kentucky uses 'Source ID' (e.g., '21-015-00236'), Michigan uses 'State Registration Number' (e.g., 'B1557', 'P0243'). Extract the identifier value without the label. This is critical for cross-referencing permits in state databases. Leave null if not stated.

initialConstructionCommencedNotification.description: True if permit requires notification of construction commencement date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

constructionCommencedNotificationWindowD.description: Number of days within which construction commencement must be reported (e.g., 30). Leave null if not specified.

initialStartupNotificationRequired.description: True if permit requires notification of initial startup date. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

startupNotificationWindowDays.description: Number of days within which startup must be reported (e.g., 15). Leave null if not specified.

permitCopyOnsiteRequired.description: True if permit requires keeping a copy onsite. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

rightOfEntryClause.description: Free-text excerpt of right-of-entry language enabling inspection, especially noting timing (e.g., 'whenever the facility is in operation'). Leave null if not stated.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes for documenting permit-level extraction decisions. Use ONLY when: (1) multiple permit identifiers exist and you selected the primary one; (2) ambiguity in facility name or address required clarification; (3) date format was ambiguous. Leave null if extraction was straightforward.

generatorSets.description: Array of generator set objects. Do not merge generator sets even if they share make/model. List in order they appear in the document.

items.description: One entry per generator unit or group as listed in the permit (e.g., EG01, EG04-EG05, 1510-4).

referenceNumber.description: Unit or group identifier exactly as used in the permit. May be single unit (e.g., 'EG01', 'EUGEN1', '01A') or group (e.g., 'EG04-EG05', 'EG01 - EG06'). Copy verbatim including spaces and formatting. Do not merge references.

numGenerators.description: Count of physical engines/generators in this reference. For single units, use 1. For grouped references (e.g., 'EG01-EG06'), extract the count if explicitly stated (e.g., 'six generators' → 6, 'fifteen generators' → 15). If count is ambiguous or not stated, use null. Do NOT infer from reference numbers.

includedInPermitProject.description: True if explicitly stated as 'new' or 'included in this permit action'; false if stated as 'existing' or 'previously permitted'; null if status not mentioned. This indicates whether equipment is being newly permitted or is existing.

originalPermitDate.description: Date when this specific equipment was originally permitted or construction commenced, in YYYY-MM-DD format if unambiguous. Often found in equipment lists under columns like 'Original Permit Date', 'Construction Commenced', 'Date Issued', or similar. May differ from permitIssuanceDate when equipment was previously permitted and is being included in a renewal or modification. Extract and convert to YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 'September 2007' → '2007-09-01', '8/23/2016' → '2016-08-23', '2/26/2007' → '2007-02-26', '1990' → '1990-01-01', '2004' → '2004-01-01'). For partial dates like 'September 2007' or year-only dates like '1990', use first of month/year. Leave null if not stated.

equipmentFacilityID.description: Equipment-specific facility identifier or unit designation exactly as written in equipment tables. This is distinct from the referenceNumber (permit reference like 'EU-01A') and represents internal facility naming conventions (e.g., '1A', '1B', '2A', 'EPD', 'EPE', 'EPF'). Some states like Kentucky show this in a 'Facility ID' column separate from the 'EU' column. Extract verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

make.description: Manufacturer name as stated in permit (e.g., 'Cummins', 'Caterpillar', 'MTU', 'Kohler'). If multiple options given (e.g., 'Caterpillar or equivalent'), select first explicitly named. Leave null if not stated. Do not infer from context.

model.description: Model designation as stated in permit (e.g., 'QSK78-G12', '3516C', '3512'). If multiple options, select first explicitly named. Leave null if not stated. Do not infer.

ratedCapacityKW.description: Rated electrical output in kilowatts as a number (e.g., 2500, 600, 2000). Extract value without units. If stated in megawatts (MW), convert to kW (×1000) and extract the number. If range given, use typical/nominal value if indicated, otherwise use smallest. Do not convert from HP/BHP. Leave null if not stated.

ratedCapacityBHP.description: Rated brake horsepower as a number (e.g., 4060, 967, 1676). Extract value without units. Do not convert from kW. Leave null if not stated. Use this field when permit explicitly states 'BHP' or 'bhp'.

ratedCapacityHP.description: Rated horsepower as a number (e.g., 3634, 3633, 1676, 2550). Extract value without units. Do not convert from kW. Leave null if not stated. Use this field when permit states 'HP' or 'hp' without the 'brake' designation. Some states (e.g., Illinois, Kentucky) use 'HP' terminology while others (e.g., Virginia) use 'BHP'. Both represent engine power output. NOTE: If permit mentions 'maximum capacity', treat it as rated capacity and use this field.

ratedCapacityMMBtuPerHr.description: Rated thermal/heat input capacity in MMBtu/hr (million BTU per hour) as a number (e.g., 15.54, 11.73, 17.85). Extract value without units. Some states like Kentucky explicitly list this in equipment tables under 'Capacity (MMBtu/hr)' column. Do not convert from kW or HP - only extract if explicitly stated. Leave null if not stated.

primaryFuelType.description: Primary fuel type exactly as written in permit. States use various terms: 'diesel fuel', 'distillate oil', 'no. 2 distillate', 'ultra-low sulfur diesel', 'natural gas', 'propane', etc. Extract verbatim without normalizing. If multiple fuel grades are allowed (e.g., 'Grades No. 1 and 2'), use the fuelGrade field and record the general category here. Leave null if not stated.

secondaryFuelType.description: Secondary fuel type for dual-fuel generators exactly as written. Leave null if not applicable.

otherFuels.description: Additional fuels beyond primary and secondary, as free text. Leave null if not applicable.

fuelGrade.description: Fuel grade exactly as stated in the permit. States use various formats: 'Grade No. 2-D', 'Grade No. 1-D S15', 'Grades No. 1 and 2', '#2 diesel', etc. Extract verbatim. If multiple grades are allowed, record them all here. Leave null if not stated.

fuelSpecification.description: Fuel specification standard if cited (e.g., 'ASTM D975', 'ASTM D396'). Copy verbatim. Leave null if not stated.

fuelSulfurContentPct.description: Sulfur content as percentage value. If stated as ppm (e.g., 15 ppm), convert to percent (0.0015). If stated as percent (e.g., 0.15%), extract as decimal (0.0015). States may express this differently - extract the numeric value that represents the actual percentage. Examples: '15 ppm' → 0.0015, '0.0015%' → 0.0015, '0.15%' → 0.0015. Leave null if not stated.

fuelCertificationRequired.description: True if fuel supplier certification is explicitly required with each shipment. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

fuelChangePermitTrigger.description: Free-text excerpt of permit language describing when fuel changes trigger permit modification (e.g., 'A change in the fuel may require a new or amended permit'). Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputPerUnitLimit.description: Maximum fuel consumption per unit as numeric value only (e.g., gallons per year per unit). For per-unit limits or when only one limit type exists. When permits specify BOTH per-unit AND combined throughput limits, use this for per-unit and fuelThroughputCombinedLimit for aggregate. Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputPerUnitScope.description: Scope of per-unit fuel throughput limit: 'per_unit' if applied to each generator individually, 'combined_group' if applied to multiple generators collectively (check fuelThroughputPerUnitGroupRef for the group reference), or 'facility_wide' if applied to all generators. States may use flexible group names like 'FGEMGENS' or specific generator lists. Leave null if not stated.

fuelThroughputPerUnitGroupRef.description: Reference to generator group when per-unit throughput applies to a group. May be explicit list (e.g., 'EG01-EG07') or flexible group identifier used by state (e.g., 'FGEMGENS'). Extract exactly as written. Leave null if not applicable.

fuelThroughputCombinedLimit.description: Combined/aggregate fuel throughput limit when permits specify BOTH per-unit and combined limits. Captures the more restrictive aggregate cap for a group of generators. Leave null if only per-unit limit exists or if not specified.

fuelThroughputCombinedGroupRef.description: Reference to generator group when combined fuel throughput limit applies. Extract the specific language describing which units. Leave null if fuelThroughputCombinedLimit not used.

controlTechnology.description: Emission control technology or devices as written in permit (e.g., 'turbocharged engine and aftercooler', 'SCR', 'DOC'). Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursPerUnitLimit.description: Maximum allowed operating hours per unit as numeric value (e.g., 500 hours/year each unit). When permits specify BOTH per-unit AND combined limits, use this field for the per-unit value and operatingHoursCombinedLimit for the aggregate. When only one limit type exists, use this field regardless of scope. See operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow for period definition. Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow.description: Rolling window or time period for per-unit operating hours limit exactly as written. States use various formats: 'consecutive 12-month period; calculated monthly', 'running 12 month total', '12-month rolling period', etc. Extract verbatim. Applies to operatingHoursPerUnitLimit unless operatingHoursCombinedRollingWindow specifies differently for combined limit. Leave null if not specified.

operatingHoursCombinedLimit.description: Combined/aggregate operating hours limit when permits specify BOTH per-unit and combined limits (e.g., '500 hours/year each' in operatingHoursPerUnitLimit AND 'total combined runtime for all fourteen...shall not exceed 3,220 hours/year' here). Critical for capturing dual-limit scenarios where individual units have one cap and the group has a more restrictive aggregate cap. Leave null if only per-unit limit exists or if not specified.

operatingHoursCombinedGroupRef.description: Reference to generator group when combined operating hours limit applies. Extract the specific language describing which units (e.g., 'all fourteen 2,500 kW (3,634 HP) Diesel-Powered Emergency Generator Sets', 'EGC5-EGC8'). Leave null if operatingHoursCombinedLimit not used.

operatingHoursCombinedRollingWindow.description: Rolling window for combined operating hours limit if different from operatingHoursRollingWindow. Extract verbatim. Leave null if not specified or if same as operatingHoursRollingWindow.

allowedOperatingModes.description: Operating modes allowed exactly as written in permit. States use various phrasings: 'emergency only', 'emergency, maintenance and testing', 'emergency and non-emergency with approval', 'any operation other than emergency operation, maintenance and testing, emergency demand response...is prohibited' (extract full prohibition language), or detailed NSPS/MACT operational definitions (40 CFR 60.4211(f), etc.). Extract verbatim regardless of format. Leave null if not specified.

opacityLimitPercent.description: Opacity limit as percent if explicitly stated (e.g., 20 for 20%). Leave null if not stated.

hourMeterRequired.description: True if hour meter is explicitly required. False if explicitly not required. Null if not mentioned.

observationFrequency.description: Monitoring/observation frequency exactly as written (e.g., 'daily when operated', 'monthly', 'quarterly'). Leave null if not specified.

recordkeepingWindowYears.description: Number of years to retain records if explicitly stated (e.g., 5). Leave null if not specified.

nspsSubpartIIII.description: True if NSPS Subpart IIII is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

mactSubpartZZZZ.description: True if MACT Subpart ZZZZ is explicitly stated as applicable. False if explicitly stated as not applicable. Null if not mentioned.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes documenting extraction decisions (e.g., multiple make/model options, capacity ambiguities). Leave null if straightforward.
